shortDescription: On Polymarket’s “LoL: Hanwha Life Esports vs. Bilibili Gaming – Worlds Group Stage” market, the “Yes” probability for “Any Player to Get a Quadra Kill” rose from 50% to 90%, a 40-percentage-point increase. According to ChainCatcher, the change occurred over the past hour.
